summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ArtistKhojo MVP. 40/40 backend pytest tests passed (100%). All key frontend flows verified end-to-end: Landing -> Login (mock OTP 123456) -> Role select -> Customer & Artist dashboards -> Browse/Filters -> Admin login & panel. Mocked services (OTP, Razorpay wallet) behave per spec. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: On upsert, $set spreads new payload but does NOT recompute 'verification_submitted' flag. If artist re-submits profile without aadhaar/intro_video, flag stays True from first submission; if first submission was without files, flag stays False even after later upload. Recommend recomputing verification_submitted on every upsert based on new aadhaar_file + intro_video presence.
Pydantic ArtistProfileIn does not validate portfolio length, but Frontend says 'exactly 4 items'. Backend should enforce 0 or 4 items max for consistency.
Allows arbitrary status transitions (e.g., cancelled -> completed). No state machine enforcement.
No uniqueness check - a customer can post multiple reviews for the same booking, inflating ratings.

Public detail endpoint exposes private fields aadhaar_file/intro_video/whatsapp/email via raw _enrich? Actually _public_artist strips them, so detail response is clean. However the response augments via _enrich and returns the public projection - verified OK.

issues: Looks polished. Hero text contrast good. Featured section renders verified artists correctly.
Filter panel readable. Category pills horizontally scrollable.

action_items: (Optional) Recompute verification_submitted on every artist upsert based on aadhaar_file + intro_video presence so admin queue reflects current state.
(Optional) Enforce single review per booking (unique index on booking_id in reviews collection or check before insert).
(Optional) Enforce booking status state machine (pending_payment -> confirmed -> completed/cancelled, no backward transitions).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - should migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI 0.110+).
JWT_SECRET defaults to 'dev-secret' if env missing; backend/.env has artistkhojo-super-secret-change-me which is fine for dev. Production must rotate.
ADMIN_PASSWORD stored plain in env; acceptable for hardcoded admin pattern but document this.
Review uniqueness not enforced - same customer can spam reviews per booking (rating system trust issue).
Booking status transition missing state machine validation.
Base64 file storage on artist_profiles (aadhaar + intro_video + portfolio) will bloat documents; acceptable per user choice but consider GridFS in production.
Frontend testid for book/share on artist profile uses prefix 'profile-' (not 'artist-') - main agent may want consistent naming.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@artistkhojo.in / Admin@123. OTP: 123456 for any 10-digit phone. /app/memory/test_credentials.md was empty.
seed_data_creation: Test run created users with phones starting 99/98 + timestamp suffix, one TEST_Artist_<runid> verified profile, requirements, bookings, wallet txns, and a review (rating 5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 40 backend pytest tests pass. UI flows verified: landing, login (OTP), role select, customer dashboard, artist dashboard (Profile/Verification/Customer Requirements/Bookings tabs all render), browse + filters, admin login + admin panel stats showing data. ArtistProfile public page testids are profile-book-btn / profile-book-now-btn / profile-share-btn (not artist-*). Backend is in-memory MongoDB so seeded data is per-pod-lifetime. Backend uses {_id:0} projections everywhere - no ObjectId leaks. No retest needed unless main agent introduces breaking changes.
